task: Fix silent workflow hangs by propagating background failures to workflow execution state across four defect sites: summarize_conversation_node swallowed exceptions, _interrupt_predecessor_state skipping IN_PROGRESS states, base_node finish_state guard, and interrupt path in-flight state marking.

key_reasoning.reason: Four defect sites across SummarizeConversationCommandNode, WorkflowExecutionService (_interrupt_predecessor_state and fail/finish), BaseNode.__call__(), and WorkflowExecutor — BaseNode is a shared base class used by all workflow nodes, triggering the 'touches core shared utilities' red flag that bumped this from M(3) to L(4).

Fixes are 1–5 lines each and follow the existing start_state/finish_state contract, but the threading model (background threads, FastAPI BackgroundTasks, ThoughtConsumer thread pool) means incorrect exception handling could introduce new race conditions; reasoning about concurrency under the existing patterns warrants M.

4 source files to modify (summarize_conversation_node.py, workflow_execution_service.py, base_node.py, workflow.py) plus 3–4 test files across tests/codemie/workflows/ and tests/codemie/service/workflow_execution/ — approximately 7 files spanning 3 directories, squarely in M range.

Changes span the Workflow orchestration layer (workflow.py, base_node.py), Service layer (workflow_execution_service.py), and Node implementation layer (summarize_conversation_node.py) — 2–3 distinct layers with no DB schema change, no API layer change, and no external service integration.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M(3) to L(4): BaseNode is the shared base class for all workflow nodes — touching its exception handler constitutes 'touches core shared utilities'.
